name: The Supper Bell District
prompt: Gather field kitchens around a tall bell frame. Each kitchen sends a different dish by handcart to a zigzag of shared tables where the first diners are being served.

name: The Lantern Menders
prompt: Lay out a temporary city of silk lantern frames and mending tents. A small procession carries one newly covered lantern past heaps of bamboo ribs and occupied seamstresses' benches.

name: A Parade Folds Away
prompt: Show hinged parade floats opening into overnight sleeping cabins. One float rolls in, one unfolds at its campsite, and a settled row has tiny porches and washing lines.

name: The Costume Crossing
prompt: Build a busy festival wardrobe around an open changing court. Dressers wheel feathered headpieces to a departure gate while returning performers hand costumes to repair crews.

name: Paper Roofs After Rain
prompt: Stage a festival district drying out after a shower. Crews raise printed cloth roofs above the food stalls while musicians shake water from a bandstand awning into tubs.
